status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
ticketScore: strict-OOS probability multiplied by JRA official odds; wide uses official lower bound
allocation: first allocate 100 yen to the highest-score ticket in each required bet type; then allocate the remaining seventeen 100-yen units to the currently highest ticketScore among all top-10 candidates, skipping any ticket already at the 200-yen cap; continue until exactly 2000 yen is spent
diagnostic: compute all-race return and an outcome-aware oracle best-five-races-per-raceDate-venue ceiling only to decide whether a future-blind race selector can possibly be worthwhile; oracle is never a model or a selectable production rule
ifOracleCeilingAtLeast200: lock a strict prior-date race-selection model before evaluating its ROI
ifOracleCeilingBelow200: discard this portfolio without training a race selector
